Schnittstelle Pred3<A1,A2,A3>

Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first argument
A2 - the type of the second argument
A3 - the type of the third argument
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Deferrable3<A1,A2,A3,Boolean>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Pred3<A1,A2,A3> extends Deferrable3<A1,A2,A3,Boolean>

A ternary predicate f: A1 × A2 × A3 → {true, false}.

Contract: inputs must not be null. Combinators operate with short‑circuit semantics between predicates (this vs. other) where applicable (e.g., and, or).

Seit:
1.0.0

    • not

      static <A1,A2,A3> Pred3<A1,A2,A3> not(@NonNull Pred3<? super A1, ? super A2, ? super A3> pred3)

      Returns the logical negation of the given Pred3.

      Contract: pred3 must not be null.

      Typparameter:

      A2 - the type of the second argument
      A3 - the type of the third argument

      pred3 - the predicate to negate; must not be null

    • and

      default @NonNull Pred3<A1,A2,A3> and(@NonNull Pred3<A1,A2,A3> other)

      Returns the logical conjunction of this predicate and other. Short‑circuits: other is evaluated only if this.test(a1, a2, a3) is true.

      Parameter:
      other - the predicate to combine with; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a predicate representing this AND other
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • and

      Logical conjunction with a BooleanSupplier. Short‑circuits: the supplier is invoked only if this.test(a1, a2, a3) is true.

      Parameter:
      booleanSupplier - supplies the right‑hand boolean; must not be null

      a predicate representing this AND booleanSupplier

    • defer

      default @NonNull Callable<Boolean> defer(@NonNull Supplier<A1> supplier1, @NonNull Supplier<A2> supplier2, @NonNull Supplier<A3> supplier3)

      Delays the evaluation of this predicate until all three inputs are supplied by the given Suppliers.

      Contract: suppliers must not be null and must not supply null values.

      Angegeben von:
      defer in Schnittstelle Deferrable3<A1,A2,A3,Boolean>
      Parameter:
      supplier1 - supplies the first input; must not be null
      supplier2 - supplies the second input; must not be null
      supplier3 - supplies the third input; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Callable that evaluates the predicate when called
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any supplier is null or supplies null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
